title: Yellow Citrusy Vietnamese Bryndza Cheese Noodles
description: This Vietnamese dish features bryndza cheese and a pasta water emulsion, making for a floral and chewy weeknight meal that is ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining the noodles.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the minced garlic and grated ginger until fragrant.
Add the lemon and grapefruit juices to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the crumbly bryndza cheese to the skillet and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the reserved pasta water to the skillet and stir to combine, creating a creamy emulsion.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to coat with the cheese sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with additional grated ginger if desired.
